transitions.fromEn: The paper bag holds the words “Listen remains”
transitions.toEn: The salt line remains on the sill
transitions.narrativeZh: 阿汐没有擦去枕边延至窗台的盐线。
transitions.narrativeEn: Axi leaves the salt line running from the pillow to the sill untouched.
transitions.npcReactionZh: 夜风从门缝穿过，没有带走盐线。
transitions.npcReactionEn: Night wind passes through the open door without taking the salt line.
transitions.atlasHookZh: 窗台上未被擦去的盐线
transitions.atlasHookEn: The salt line left on the sill

transitions.fromZh: 门已合上，按钮未被敲响
transitions.fromEn: The doors are shut; the button has not been struck
transitions.toEn: The button moves forward on its own
transitions.narrativeZh: 无人敲响的钟仍留下了一个可见的变化。
transitions.narrativeEn: The unstruck bell leaves a visible change behind.
transitions.npcReactionZh: 门内无人应声，按钮停在新的位置。
transitions.npcReactionEn: No one answers from within; the button rests in its new position.
transitions.atlasHookZh: 未敲响的钟与前移的按钮
transitions.atlasHookEn: The unstruck bell and its moved button

transitions.fromEn: The empty nail has been placed in the paper bag

transitions.narrativeEn: After the sea takes the empty nail, one line remains in the bag.
transitions.npcReactionZh: 阿汐收起纸袋，没有再添字。
transitions.npcReactionEn: Axi keeps the paper bag and adds no further words.
transitions.atlasHookEn: The words left after the empty nail is taken

transitions.fromEn: The final line of the unfinished ledger is blank

transitions.npcReactionZh: 账页仍摊开着，无人写下名字。
transitions.npcReactionEn: The ledger remains open; no name is written.

atlasDraft.pZh: 天亮时，盐线还在窗台。她把纸袋放在门边，没有装进去。风从门缝经过，袋口那行字仍旧朝上。
atlasDraft.pEn: At daylight, the salt line remained on the sill. She set the paper bag by the door without putting it inside. Wind passed through the gap; the line of writing at the mouth still faced upward.
atlasDraft.codaZh: 门没有再开。纸袋留在原处。
atlasDraft.codaEn: The door did not open again. The bag stayed where it was.
